# ResumeTimer <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [System](BlitzPlus-System)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ResumeTimer:Void timer:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `timer` | In | Int32 | required | A timer from `CreateTimer`. |

## Description

Lets a timer paused with [PauseTimer](PauseTimer) tick again.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Timer", 20, 20, 240, 100, Desktop(), 3)
tm = CreateTimer(2)
PauseTimer tm
ResumeTimer tm
Repeat
	e = WaitEvent()
	If e = $4001 Then SetGadgetText win, "Tick " + EventData()
Until e = $803
```
